candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud
verified_facts: The archive contains time-stamped three-dimensional x,y,z LIDAR points and component attributes.
Point-cloud processing classifies returns into ground and surface-object classes.
Manual editing of the derived DTM means classified ground points need not match the final DTM.
Historic archiving means a matching point cloud may not exist for every derived surface model.
Metadata declares EPSG:27700 and +/-15 cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
semantic_limits: Raw or classified point-cloud returns must not silently replace the SHA-bound final DTM without exact survey and processing lineage.

candidates.publisher: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
candidates.name: LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model (DTM) 10m
verified_facts: The product is a 10 m bare-earth DTM covering about 99% of England.
EA states it was resampled from the 2 m DTM using bilinear interpolation.
It is aligned to the OS National Grid, presented in metres and referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn using OSTN15.
Individual LIDAR surveys used by the composite had +/-15 cm RMSE vertical accuracy.
semantic_limits: The 10 m bilinearly resampled grid is not treated as a parcel-scale accuracy upgrade over the 1 m primary DTM.
